title: 5 Anime Villains Everyone Wanted to See Become Heroes
content: The anime industry also follows the basic structure of a fictional narrative by giving protagonists a journey in which antagonists appear as obstacles. These villains often emerge from the clichéd trope of seeking power and global dominance, with the heroes doing their best to stop them.

title: Writer Ichiha Hiiragi, Artist mimita Launch New Manga on July 15
